purpose: Define faithful Phase07-to-mainstream adapter requirements before running official OpenPI, GR00T, Diffusion Policy, or RT-X comparisons.

source_phase07_data.available_video_source: Phase07 rollout NPZ/video artifacts, not present in residual_label_records.csv itself.

common_bridge_decision.recommended_mainstream_action_surface_fo: 7D relative end-effector/gripper action where possible: dx, dy, dz, droll, dpitch, dyaw, gripper
common_bridge_decision.bridge_risk: A mainstream VLA/diffusion model trained only to output Phase07 residual controller parameters would not be a faithful comparison to official mainstream manipulation policies.
required_resolution: Use official mainstream methods on a low-level or 7D end-effector action bridge when possible.
If only residual-parameter action training is possible, label it as a diagnostic adapter and not as a faithful mainstream comparison.
Document concrete blocker if official action-space assumptions cannot be mapped to Newton Panda hydro without changing the task.

implementation_update_2026_06_27.existing_old_npz_status: older Phase07 held-out NPZ artifacts still lack these fields and should not be treated as bridge-ready

official_basis: checkpoint weight loader such as gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_base/params or DROID checkpoints

phase07_mapping_candidate.image.base_0_rgb: newton.camera.color_rgba workspace camera view extracted from rollout NPZ/video artifacts
phase07_mapping_candidate.image.left_wrist_0_rgb: optional Newton camera view if available; otherwise mask false for non-required slot
phase07_mapping_candidate.prompt: grasp and lift the water cup while adapting to fill mass and friction without dropping it
phase07_mapping_candidate.actions_preferred: 7D EEF/gripper action derived from Newton Panda hydro waypoint/controller commands if available

blockers_before_faithful_run: Need Phase07 low-level or EEF action traces, not only residual feedback labels.
Need LeRobot dataset conversion without held-out leakage.
Need official checkpoint download into an approved checkpoint/cache path.
Need OpenPI env prepared under envs/ before compute allocation.

official_basis: relative EEF action space when applicable
gr00t_bridge.target_dataset_format: GR00T LeRobot v2 with meta/info.json, episodes.jsonl, tasks.jsonl, modality.json, parquet data, and mp4 videos

phase07_modality_candidate.video.wrist: optional Newton camera view if consistently available
phase07_modality_candidate.action.single_arm_preferred: relative EEF delta action bridge from Newton Panda controller trajectory
phase07_modality_candidate.language: grasp and lift the water cup while adapting to hidden or misleading fill cues

blockers_before_faithful_run: Need modality.json that matches actual Phase07 state/action arrays.
Need official GR00T env under envs/ and checkpoint download policy.
Need confirm whether Newton Panda hydro action bridge can be represented as GR00T relative EEF or joint-space action.
Need closed-loop simulation wrapper if moving beyond open-loop action MSE.

diffusion_policy_bridge.target_dataset_format: official Diffusion Policy replay buffer/zarr-style dataset or compatible Dataset implementation

phase07_mapping_candidate.obs.image: workspace camera frames if using ImagePolicy

blockers_before_faithful_run: Need decide and implement preferred action surface.
Need dataset conversion under compute-safe workflow.
Need EnvRunner that runs Newton held-out rollouts and writes the same metrics/videos.
Need official environment prepared under envs/ before GPU use.

official_basis: RGB workspace image plus task string

phase07_mapping_candidate.observation.image: single workspace RGB frame at approximately 3 Hz
phase07_mapping_candidate.observation.task_string: grasp and lift the water cup while adapting to fill and friction
phase07_mapping_candidate.action: 7D gripper-frame x,y,z,roll,pitch,yaw,opening mapped to Newton Panda hydro command interface

blockers_before_faithful_run: Need map RT-X 7D action to Newton Panda hydro controller without changing the task.
Need determine whether RT-X single RGB input can handle Phase07 hidden/misleading fill cue conditions without contact/tactile input.
Need JAX/Flax environment under envs/ before compute use.

mainstream_gate_remains_open_until: official checkpoint comparison runs on Phase07
or concrete incompatibility blocker is recorded per candidate
